## Structure and components

- [statement] Trace content requires data governance: MongoDB’s agent-template repository warns that stored conversations and traces can contain database names, collection names, field names, and documents read by the agent. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/agents · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The Monitoring UI tracks invocation volume, error rates, token usage, memory activity, and resource consumption for a project and its workspaces. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitoring-ui.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Monitoring latency p50 and p95 include approval waiting time. Trace inspection distinguishes active execution from human review time, so approval delays require separate interpretation from slow execution. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitoring-ui.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Agent Engine records execution traces automatically; runs can be inspected for model calls, tool calls, timing, and errors. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation · also: https://github.com/mongodb/agents
- [statement] Native traces organize conversations into sessions, runs, and steps. The Playground shows the current user’s interactive sessions; Monitor > Traces covers project sessions across workspaces and invocation channels. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Treat trace token totals as lower bounds: session totals omit some usage such as memory extraction, and active runs can undercount until steps finish. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Interpret health metrics carefully: invocations exclude runs waiting for approval, while latency percentiles include time spent waiting for approval. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitoring-ui.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Policy denial monitoring counts tool authorization and execution/session budget denials, but excludes model authorization denials; the displayed count is therefore not a complete count of every policy denial. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitoring-ui.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitor.md
- [statement] Runtime logs capture stdout/stderr, print statements, logging calls, and framework debug output; the runtime-log API supports filtering by execution and session IDs to correlate logs with traces. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitor.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md
- [statement] The Python runner architecture documents execution logging to JSONL and MongoDB plus OpenTelemetry tracing, including JSONL and MongoDB span exporters. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/sdk/python/packages/agent-engine-runner-shared.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Arize documents an Agent Engine trace-export integration for observability and evaluation; Moor Insights also reports integrations with observability and evaluation providers. (medium confidence) — https://arize.com/blog/using-arize-ax-with-mongodb-atlas-agent-engine/ · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation · also: https://moorinsightsstrategy.com/field-notes/mongodb-atlas-agent-engine-makes-context-a-shared-platform-for-agents/
- [statement] Arize’s integration article describes online evaluation of both final outputs and execution paths, annotation queues for failures, and reviewed examples becoming experimental datasets for comparing changes before redeployment. These are Arize AX capabilities described by the integration vendor. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://arize.com/blog/using-arize-ax-with-mongodb-atlas-agent-engine/ · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Arize says its integration ingests OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions and OpenInference, and accepts OTLP-emitting runtimes on Agent Engine without custom instrumentation code; this statement is conditional on the runtime already emitting OTLP. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://arize.com/blog/using-arize-ax-with-mongodb-atlas-agent-engine/ · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Kegan Quimby characterizes the launch claims as lacking independent production evaluation and argues that independent customer evaluations would be more persuasive than launch testimonials; this is an attributed critique, not a benchmark result. (low confidence) — https://keganquimby.com/articles/mongodb-atlas-agent-engine-2026/ · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Agent Engine records execution traces automatically, including model/tool steps, timing, and token usage; Arize describes span-level inspection of this telemetry for debugging agent behavior. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation · also: https://arize.com/blog/using-arize-ax-with-mongodb-atlas-agent-engine/
- [statement] The Monitoring UI tracks project and workspace invocations, errors, tokens, memory activity, and resource usage, with selectable 1h, 24h, 7d, and 30d periods and automatic refresh every 60 seconds. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitoring-ui.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Interpret trace token totals as lower bounds: they omit some usage such as memory extraction. Session timeline token and memory totals also undercount while runs or steps remain unfinished. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/inspect-traces.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Runtime logs capture stdout/stderr, print statements, logging calls, and framework debug output. Log entries expose executionId, sessionId, and traceId, supporting correlation between runtime logs and traces. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agentengine/manage/monitor.md · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
- [statement] Arize’s published export instructions require customer mirroring, Full content, and Always on sampling. Full content sends prompts, completions, and tool payloads; verify the current export controls before enabling this configuration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://arize.com/blog/using-arize-ax-with-mongodb-atlas-agent-engine/ · keywords: Agent Engine observability and evaluation
